messages:
alex: Quick async check-in — API GW / routing / auth / rate limits
alex: Yesterday: merged routing fix for path-based policies, rolled out to staging (canary on 2 nodes)
alex: Blocker: seeing 429 spikes in staging for bursty clients, looks like our burst window is too small — need someone to validate rate-limiter token bucket config
alex: Today: adding more telemetry, will run a targeted load test and open a PR for increasing burst tokens
maria: Thanks. I can take a look at the rate-limiter config after standup. Ping me when you have the load test gist.
maria: FYI, I've got a PR for JWT key rotation to avoid auth restarts — needs review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/462
kevin: Re: 429s — saw similar in canary yesterday. Try raising `burst_capacity` from 10 -> 30 for the policy id `gw-rate-default` and replay the 1s spike test
kevin: Also confirm we are sending X-RateLimit-Remaining header; I noticed clients not handling the missing header gracefully
alex: Opened ticket INF-980 to track the 429s + logs. Will attach k6 script. Here's quick curl to check headers:
alex: ```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $JWT" https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
alex: Should show `X-RateLimit-Limit` and `X-RateLimit-Remaining`
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy of gateway-routing v2 -> nodes gw-canary-1, gw-canary-2 succeeded :tada:
jon: I can review PR 462 later today. If you want quicker eyes, @maria can you also +1 the rotation test plan?
maria: Yep, I'll review the PR and the test plan after lunch. Also, tagging @sarah for observability — we need histograms for burst latencies
sarah: On it — I'll add a per-policy latency histogram and a 95/99 latency alert to the console dashboards. ETA EOD
kevin: Quick heads-up: if we increase burst too high we might see head-of-line blocking on small GPUs in Dedicated. Let's simulate with mixed-size traces
alex: Good point. I'll add a scenario with mixed token lengths
alex: Blocker resolved? Not yet. Status: running k6, attaching logs to INF-980. Will update thread when done
maria: Reminder: next oncall handover is Friday 09:00 PT. Whoever is doing rotations, please include the new rate policy numbers in the doc
alex: Thanks all — ping here if you need me to run any local tests. :thumbsup:
